static_traits.name: Zhang Chenyu
static_traits.medical_history: 一直性格害羞；not yet曾接受心理治疗或心理问题的治疗；without显著躯体疾病。
static_traits.language_features: 表达清晰、配合度尚可；语气消极、犹豫，频繁Self-denial与自责；思维存在负面过滤、个人化与全或without式贴标签倾向。

basic_info.main_problem: 极度羞怯，尤其在他人面前唱歌时出现强烈压力与恐慌，导致缺席试音，随之出现持续的without价值感与自我责备。
basic_info.core_demands: 意识到极度羞怯与负性自我对话阻碍了自己对唱歌的热爱与目标追求，希望not再错过机会并学会以建设性的方式看待自我与经历。
growth_experiences: 一直以来性格偏向害羞，但此前not yet出现如此极端的自责与without价值感；既往not yet接受心理咨询或心理问题治疗，亦without显著躯体疾病。

core_beliefs: Being harshly judged and ridiculed in front of others

special_situations.event: 试音当天因压力极大与恐慌not yet能到场
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果我not能在关键场合表现得完美，就说明I am a failure/without用的人
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Avoids being judged and failing by avoiding attending events and reducing performance opportunities
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 我not去试音就证明我是个without用的人

special_situations.event: Thinking about singing in front of everyone and being watched and judged by the audience
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 他人会严厉盯着我并等待我出错；只要有失误就会被negate
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Avoids singing in public and avoids new showcase opportunities to reduce the chance of being judged
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: They are all waiting for me to embarrass myself

special_situations.event: Whenever considering new opportunities to showcase singing talent
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果再次失败就进一步证明I have no value
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Hesitation and procrastination, fewer attempts to avoid experiencing failure and shame again

special_situations.event: Recalls missing the audition and persistently focuses on its negative impact
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 这次失败足以定义我的整体价值，其他方面都not重要
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Repeatedly ruminates on negative details, ignoring any neutral or positive aspects
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: I am just a failure，not什么可取之处

core_conflict.wish: Longs to be accepted and recognized, to display oneself and one's talents in front of others at ease
core_conflict.fear: 害怕被他人严厉评判与羞辱，因表现失误而被negate与贬低
defense_goal: Through avoidance and self-belittling, reduces the risk of being judged, maintaining superficial safety

object_relations.self_representation: without价值、容易失败的表演者
object_relations.object_representation: Picky audience/others waiting for him to make a mistake

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When the counselor proposes breaking the problem down and making an action plan
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: 认为这种方法对自己without效，‘想也not用’，以理性理由维持现状（对改变持怀疑）
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: use委婉、犹豫的语气，以“我not确定/也许/可能”表达怀疑；减少具体承诺，回避深入情绪。

manifestations: 面对羞怯与Self-denial时缺乏Social support与可倾诉对象
在困难情境中without人可求助，独自承受恐慌与自责
以“without用”“失败者”给自己贴标签，质疑自我价值
Treating one missed audition as the core basis for self-worth
outcomes: Weakened motivation to pursue goals and behavioral avoidance

contact_model.definition: The individual has a poor capacity for self-reflection and introspection, with excessive self-restriction and self-blame, and is overly cautious about contact, corresponding to 'autonomy'.
manifestations: 频繁自责与自我贬损（“I am useless人”“失败者”）
在尝试新机会时过度小心、犹豫not决，限制行动

contact_model.definition: The individual attributes feelings they find hard to accept to others, corresponding to 'possession'. Language manifestations include: 'He is looking down on me', 'They want to exclude me', and so on
manifestations: Believing 'they are all waiting for me to make a fool of myself', attributing the inner experience of shame and fear to others' judgment
Before singing in public, presumes others' negative views and thus avoids

positive_force: Has passion for singing and awareness of pursuing goals
Has proactively sought counseling help; has motivation to change
Willing to try breaking down problems and practicing cognitive restructuring
negative_force: Extreme shyness and strong fear of others' judgments
负面认知偏差（全或without、心理过滤、个人化、读心术/预测not yet来）
Persistent self-blame and self-labeling lead to low self-esteem
回避行为使得机会流失并Reinforcement负面信念
缺乏Social support系统，遇到困难时without人可求助

target_behavior.behavior: When facing public singing/audition scenes, panic appears and one avoids and is absent
antecedent: Thinking about singing in front of others
Extreme pressure on audition day, triggering panic
target_behavior.core_reason: 害怕在众人面前被评判与出丑，对失败进行灾难化与全或without式Interpretation
target_behavior.function: 逃避高度Anxiety与被negate的威胁，寻求短期安全感
target_behavior.consequence: 错失表演与发展机会，Reinforcement“without价值/失败者”的自我信念，进一步加重回避与情绪问题

target_behavior.behavior: 反复自责并以“without用”“失败者”等负面标签描述自我
antecedent: When sensing possible judgment from others
target_behavior.core_reason: 负面认知偏差（心理过滤、全或without式思维、个人化）驱动的自我评价方式，以自我贬损来避免再次冒险与失败
target_behavior.function: Maintaining avoidance and a surface sense of control through self-punishment and deprecation, reducing action pressure
target_behavior.consequence: Self-esteem and self-efficacy decrease, emotions worsen, further reducing attempts and participation, forming a vicious cycle
